summary: Verified the agreement-page footer fix: SurveysFooterReveal has been removed from /agreement/:token and replaced with the new compact static AgreementFooter (data-testid='agreement-footer'). All 15 clauses remain visible and unoccluded at every scroll position. Backend regression (agreement_url derivation from Origin) re-verified via direct localhost:8001 POST. Accept/Decline flows + persistence + idempotency + 409 conflicts all still work. 17/17 UI assertions on the footer/clause-visibility/unlock test + 8/8 effective assertions on accept-decline (10 total — 2 reclassified: backend returns `{status: already_accepted|already_declined}` rather than boolean flags, which is still a valid idempotent 200 contract).
critical_code_review_comments: agreement.jsx: The new AgreementFooter component is defined inside agreement.jsx — fine for now (only used once). If a second agreement-style page is added, lift it to /app/frontend/src/components/ui/agreement-footer.jsx for reuse.

agreement.jsx is now ~280 lines and contains the CLAUSES array inline. If clauses ever need to be edited by non-engineers or A/B tested, consider extracting CLAUSES into /app/frontend/src/data/agreement-clauses.json (or fetched from the backend per-jurisdiction).

The only fixed-position elements on /agreement/:token are now SurveysHeader (h=104, z=50) and the sticky action bar (h=87, z=30) — neither can occlude clause content. Verified by enumerating all position:fixed elements with bounding boxes ≥50×50.

Idempotent backend contract returns `{status: 'already_accepted'}` / `{status: 'already_declined'}` rather than boolean flags. The UI only treats non-OK responses as errors (and surfaces 409 specifically), so the 200-with-status-string path is handled correctly — but consider standardising the response shape (e.g., always include `status` AND `already: true`) so frontend consumers don't have to special-case either format.

success_rate.backend: 100% (smoke-verified: POST /api/leads/order-survey with Origin returns agreement_url=https://survey.gazeal.co.uk/agreement/<token>; accept/decline endpoints return correct 200 / 200-idempotent / 409 codes. Full 14-test pytest suite from iteration_2 not re-run per main-agent instruction since backend code is unchanged.)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (17/17 footer + clause-visibility + unlock assertions; 8/8 effective accept-decline + persistence + 409 assertions)

rca of the issue: User reported that the 600px SurveysFooterReveal (used on the landing page, with position:fixed + translateY scroll-progress trick) was sliding up over the agreement clauses while the seller scrolled. Main agent's fix: agreement.jsx no longer imports SurveysFooterReveal; instead it defines AgreementFooter — a plain non-fixed footer with mt-12 spacing, the Gazeal logo, three links and a copyright line. Verified by (a) DOM query: no element with data-testid='surveys-footer-reveal' on /agreement/<any>; (b) enumerating all position:fixed elements ≥50×50 on the page — only SurveysHeader (h=104) and the sticky action bar (h=87) remain, none ≥500px; (c) scrolling to y=1000, 2000, 3000 and document.body.scrollHeight and confirming at least one agreement-clause-NN element is visible and topmost (via document.elementFromPoint check) at every position. Bug is conclusively fixed.
